name: kultranz
description: US salary, cost-of-living, and take-home-pay data from BLS, BEA, Census, and IRS 2026 releases. Free hosted read-only tools including a full 50-state tax engine, BEA regional price parities across 50 metros, and BLS OEWS wage percentiles by occupation and metro.

http.description: Hosted Streamable HTTP endpoint. Free, no authentication required.

examples.title: Compare take-home pay across states
examples.description: Net pay for the same gross salary in two states
examples.prompt: What is the take-home pay on a $95,000 salary in Texas vs California?

examples.title: Cost-of-living adjusted salary
examples.description: Equivalent salary between two metros using BEA price parities
examples.prompt: What salary do I need in Austin to match the purchasing power of $120,000 in San Francisco?

examples.title: Occupation wage percentiles
examples.description: Real BLS OEWS wage distribution for a job in a metro
examples.prompt: Show me the 10th to 90th percentile wages for registered nurses in Chicago.

tools.name: get_take_home_pay
tools.description: Calculate net (take-home) pay from a gross US salary for 2026: federal income tax, Social Security, Medicare (including the additional surcharge), and state income tax for any of the 50 states + DC.

tools.name: compare_cost_of_living
tools.description: Compare the cost of living between two US metro areas using BEA Regional Price Parities and return the equivalent salary needed to hold the same purchasing power.

tools.name: get_tax_brackets
tools.description: Return the 2026 IRS federal income tax brackets and standard deduction, and optionally one state's income tax rules.

tools.name: list_metros
tools.description: List all 50 supported US metro areas with their BEA Regional Price Parity index, median rent, median home value, and median household income.

tools.name: get_salary_percentiles
tools.description: Return BLS OEWS annual wage percentiles (10th, 25th, median, 75th, 90th) for an occupation, optionally narrowed to a metro or state, alongside cost-of-living context.
